title: Pattern Matching
definition: Pattern matching searches for a smaller pattern inside a larger text by comparing aligned characters.
realLifeExample: It is like sliding a word strip across a sentence until every letter lines up.

algorithm.Iterative:
1. Start from the first valid alignment.
2. Compare pattern characters with text characters.
3. If all characters match, report the position.
4. Otherwise shift by one position.
5. Repeat until all alignments are tested.
algorithm.Functions:
1. Use a helper function to compare at one alignment.
2. Repeat this comparison for each possible start.
3. Return the first matching index.
algorithm.Recursion:
1. Compare current characters.
2. If they match, recurse on the next pair.
3. If they mismatch, restart from the next alignment.
4. Stop when a full match or failure is reached.
